assertions.subject: CMV retinitis
assertions.quote: Intravenous ganciclovir has been shown to delay progression of CMV retinitis

assertions.subject: CMV retinitis
assertions.quote: Dual therapy with foscarnet and ganciclovir is more effective in delaying progression of retinitis than either drug alone

assertions.subject: CMV colitis
assertions.quote: Intravenous ganciclovir is also used to treat CMV colitis

assertions.subject: CMV esophagitis
assertions.quote: Intravenous ganciclovir is also used to treat CMV esophagitis

assertions.subject: CMV pneumonitis
assertions.quote: Intravenous ganciclovir is also used to treat CMV pneumonitis

assertions.subject: CMV infection
assertions.quote: Intravenous ganciclovir, followed by either oral ganciclovir or high-dose oral acyclovir, reduces the risk of CMV infection

assertions.subject: congenital neurologic CMV disease
assertions.quote: Limited data in infants with symptomatic congenital neurologic CMV disease suggest that treatment with IV ganciclovir may reduce hearing loss

assertions.subject: Kaposi’s sarcoma
assertions.quote: The risk of Kaposi’s sarcoma is reduced in AIDS patients receiving long-term ganciclovir

assertions.subject: Antiviral drug resistance
assertions.quote: Resistance to ganciclovir increases with duration of use

assertions.subject: Antiviral drug resistance
assertions.quote: The more common mutation, in UL97, results in decreased levels of the triphosphorylated (ie, active) form of ganciclovir

assertions.subject: Antiviral drug resistance
assertions.quote: The less common UL54 mutation in DNA polymerase results in higher levels of resistance and potential cross-resistance with cidofovir and foscarnet
